description: NaBaFe₂F₉ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. Na is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine F atoms. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.26-2.91 Å. Ba is bonded in a 10-coordinate geometry to ten F atoms. There are a spread of Ba-F bond distances ranging from 2.75-3.06 Å. There are two inequivalent Fe sites. In the first Fe site, Fe is bonded to six F atoms to form corner-sharing FeF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 37-46°. There are a spread of Fe-F bond distances ranging from 1.91-2.03 Å. In the second Fe site, Fe is bonded to six F atoms to form corner-sharing FeF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 37-46°. There are a spread of Fe-F bond distances ranging from 1.91-2.05 Å. There are nine inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Ba, and one Fe atom. In the second F site, F is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na and two Fe atoms. In the third F site, F is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two equivalent Ba and one Fe atom. In the fourth F site, F is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Ba, and one Fe atom. In the fifth F site, F is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two Fe atoms. In the sixth F site, F is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na, two equivalent Ba, and one Fe atom. In the seventh F site, F is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two equivalent Ba and one Fe atom. In the eighth F site, F is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to two equivalent Na and two Fe atoms. In the ninth F site, F is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na, two equivalent Ba, and one Fe atom.
